findings.message: Test 'confirms an order after successful payment' relies solely on call/interaction assertions without verifying return values, state changes, or negative side effects.
findings.snippet: Call-only assertion 'expect(paymentMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith(100)' at line 21 verifies invocation presence without inspecting state or return values.

geminiAdvisory.rootCause: Test only checks expect(mock).toHaveBeenCalled() without inspecting return values, state changes, or business side effects. (Set GEMINI_API_KEY to query Google AI Studio live)
geminiAdvisory.suggestedAssertion: Replace interaction checks with state assertions verifying the observable outcome of the operation.
